weightAlert.text: Your weight has come down by about 1.2% of your bodyweight a week over the last 3 weeks, faster than the 1% a week usually advised. If that's more than you meant, eating a little more can ease it, and if you feel tired, low or unwell, a doctor or sports dietitian can help.

hydration.note: An estimate from your weight and the day's training, not a minimum. Thirst and pale urine are good everyday signs.
